title: A coherent module supported in the zero set of an ideal is killed by a power of it
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space), $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent] and $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, with $\mathcal K^t\mathcal F$ as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0) for $t\ge1$ and $\mathcal K^0\mathcal F=\mathcal F$; let $V(\mathcal K)=\{x\in X:\mathcal K_x\ne\mathcal O_{X,x}\}$ (the closed subset underlying the closed subscheme cut out by $\mathcal K$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]; on an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A$ it is $V(\mathcal K(\operatorname{Spec}A))$ [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-zero-set-affine]). Then $\mathcal K^t\mathcal F=0$ for some $t\ge0$ if and only if $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\subseteq V(\mathcal K)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] (2).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y9 (lemma-power-ideal-kills-sheaf, line 2569); its proof: a finite covering by spectra of Noetherian rings and Algebra, Lemma 00L6 (algebra-lemma-Noetherian-power-ideal-kills-module, algebra.tex line 14997)

proof.text: Obtain quasi-coherence and finite type of F from the already proved coherence criterion on locally Noetherian schemes. Choose a finite set S of affine opens covering X by Mathlib isCompact_and_isOpen_iff_finite_and_eq_biUnion_affineOpens. All section rings are Noetherian by IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian.

The affine support formula identifies Supp(F) intersect U with the image of V(Ann(F(U))) under U.fromSpec. The affine ideal-zero-set formula identifies V(K) intersect U with the image of V(K(U)). Injectivity of the affine open immersion and the cover imply global support containment iff these affine zero-locus containments hold for all U in S. PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_iff rewrites these as K(U) contained in radical Ann(F(U)).

By the affine-cover zero criterion the t-th ideal-power product is zero iff each K(U)^t is contained in Ann(F(U)). Such containment implies the radical containment directly: a in K(U) gives a^t in K(U)^t and hence in Ann(F(U)), including t=0. Conversely Noetherianity makes each K(U) finitely generated, and Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg provides a local exponent n(U).

Choose n(U) for U in S and let t be the Finset.sup of their values, with zero off S. Each n(U) is at most t by Finset.le_sup; Ideal.pow_le_pow_right implies K(U)^t is contained in K(U)^n(U) and then Ann(F(U)). Apply the affine-cover zero criterion. The supremum of the empty finset is zero, so no nonempty-scheme hypothesis is added.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_support_power_ideal_kills (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (K : X.IdealSheafData) : (∃ t : ℕ, IsZero (idealModuleProduct (idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2 F)) ↔ {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ {x : X | ¬ Function.Surjective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map K.toModulesι).hom}
